description:
Delta Solutions & Strategies is seeking a Software Developer with an advanced Mathematics and Physics background to join our team at our Corporate Headquarters in Colorado Springs, CO. This position will focus on maintenance and development of software dealing with high fidelity physics modeling for Missile Warning training. Successful candidates should be detail-oriented and have excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities. Advanced consideration will be provided to candidates with a Space background and knowledge of the Missile Warning and Missile Defense communities.

What you will be doing:
 
 
 Working as part of a small team on project development and integration of C# applications in a virtual environment.

 Designing, implementing, and sustaining simulation algorithms predicting orbital and suborbital trajectories.

 Deriving and coding equations of motion for boost, mid-course, and terminal guidance.

 Predicting and modeling emerging threats as events occur in the missile warning community.

 Interacting with customers to gather requirements and offer creative solutions, writing documentation, presenting project designs, performing user training, and attending requirements meetings.

 Designing, developing, documenting, testing, and debugging application software that contains logical and mathematical solutions.

 Analyzing user requirements.

 Participating in the full software life cycle: designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining applications on Microsoft Windows-based systems.

 Performing agile software development in both unclassified and classified environments while utilizing software engineering best practices including unit testing, code reviews, and design documentation.

 Other tasks as directed.


 

What you will need: 
 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in physics, engineering, applied mathematics (Masters preferred) or another relevant field.

 Advanced knowledge of relevant mathematics and physics.

 5+ years of software development experience

 Experience with C# .Net (preferred), Java, or C++

 Development in a DoD environment preferred

 Active Secret Security Clearance preferred, must be able to obtain Top Secret Security Clearance

 Experience or understanding of ITW/AA, Missile Warning, OPIR, UEWR, NDS or MDA ground/sea-based sensors highly preferred.

 Candidate must have strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills and work well in a team environment and perform independently. 


 

Delta Solutions & Strategies offers a generous benefits package to include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k), PTO, paid holidays, parental, military and jury duty paid leaves.
 
In compliance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the salary range for this position is $95,000-$130,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. Delta Solutions & Strategies considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as, market and business considerations when extending an offer.
 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not and will not discriminate in employment and personnel practices based on race, sex, age, disability, veteran status, religion, national origin or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Hiring, transferring, and promotion practices are performed without regard to the above listed items. EEO/AAP, M, F, V, D
